done_when: When every file a change touches is under docs/ or plans/, a Markdown file, or under .factory/, forge close skips forge.toml's test command and says so in one line, and still runs the review and every check forge.toml names; any other changed file runs the test command as today. Command-level tests cover a docs-and-plans-only fix (skipped) and one that also changes a code file (run).
why: Close runs the full test command even when a change touches only docs, plans, Markdown or Forge's own records, so a plan-row fix took 18 minutes in a client
